claims.assertion: Mari says she chose recurring dry-pod treatment over a two-month wet-pod restoration because she would not leave her Taygetan queen duties.

claims.assertion: Mari says Temmer time runs slower than Earth time at 4.6 to 1, delaying former Queen Alenym’s expected exit from a wet medical pod until around mid-2025 Earth time.
